tagline: Counselling for steadier days and meaningful change.
description: Virtual counselling based in Vancouver, BC with Amanda Hecimovic, RCC — support for eating disorders, disordered eating, anxiety, depression, burnout, self-worth, and life transitions.
hours: Monday to Thursday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM

insuranceNotes: Payments are processed through Jane App, and they currently accept: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, UnionPay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay
Receipts are provided and can be used for reimbursement through extended health benefits.
Coverage varies by plan, provider type, and province. I would encourage you to confirm details with your insurance provider before booking a consult or session.

If you are not covered by a provider, or they are unable to cover the entire cost of sessions, receipts may be kept and filed as a medical expense on your taxes; however, this needs to be confirmed with your accountant or by contacting the CRA.

A limited number of sliding scale spaces may be available. These spots are intended for folks who are facing financial barriers, making it difficult for them to afford counselling. You're welcome to ask about the availability of these spots. I'm happy to direct you to lower-cost counselling resources available in the community if I don't have spots available.
